entries.wording: Gate out of Empty Equipment by Truck at Depot
entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it; the cargo is not yet with Yang Ming.

entries.wording: Gate out of Empty Equipment by Truck at Port terminal
Gate in of Laden Equipment by Truck at Port terminal
entries.note: The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading.

entries.wording: Load of Laden Equipment onto Vessel at Port terminal
Departure by Vessel at Port terminal
Arrival by Vessel at Port terminal
Discharge of Laden Equipment from Vessel at Port terminal
entries.note: At a transshipment port as at the port of discharge.

entries.wording: Gate out of Laden Equipment by Truck at Port terminal
entries.note: The loaded container leaves the port by truck for the consignee.

entries.wording: Gate in of Empty Equipment by Truck at Port terminal
entries.note: The consignee returns the unloaded container. Before the container moved, it is an unused one returned.
